settings.content: A swipe-based scent quiz shown as a popup site-wide. The visitor saves up to 6 favorites and is linked through to the bundle product with their picks pre-filled. On-site copy stays in Swedish; only these settings are in English.

settings.label: Bundle product
settings.info: Added to cart when a visitor taps "Build my bundle" after the quiz, with their picks recorded as line item properties, then taken straight to checkout. Required for that button - if left blank, it shows an inline error instead of adding to cart.

settings.label: Scent collection
settings.info: Required - products swiped through in the quiz deck. Until a collection with products is picked here, the trigger button stays visible but shows a notice instead of opening the quiz. Copy (tagline, "inspired by", mood tags, second photo) is read from each product's metafields where set - see the comment at the top of snippets/scent-quiz-popup.liquid for the exact fields.

settings.label: Variant to use
settings.info: For each product in the collection above, the variant whose title contains this text is used (e.g. "50" matches "50 ml"). Falls back to the product's first available variant if none match.

settings.label: Auto-open after
settings.info: 0 = auto-open disabled. Visitors can always open the quiz manually via the floating button.

settings.label: How often the popup should auto-open
Send saved scent boards to Klaviyo
Klaviyo public API key (Site ID)
settings.info: Klaviyo > Settings > API Keys > Public API Key. Safe to use in the browser.

settings.label: Klaviyo List ID
settings.info: The list the visitor's email should be added to. Klaviyo > Lists & Segments > open the list > List ID is in the URL.

settings.content: Colours used by the premium design layer (pm-base.css). The other tokens come from the colour schemes: ink = Scheme 1 text, panel = Scheme 5 background, charcoal = Scheme 3 background, black = Scheme 4 background. Corner radii follow the Buttons and Product cards settings.

settings.info: The 1 / 2 (25% off) / 4 (30% off) / 6 (35% off) / 8 (40% off) bottle cards, opening on 4. Prices follow the automatic tier discounts. Off: product pages show the price and a plain Add to cart button.

settings.label: Add to cart button on collection cards
settings.info: Puts the bottle in the cart without leaving the collection page; the cart drawer opens.

settings.content: Badge with the perfume oil concentration of the product's line (Classic, PURE, PURE ROYAL). The values come from Admin > Content > Metaobjects > Fragrance line. A product belongs to the line whose product tag it carries, untagged perfumes are Classic. [line], [oil] and [hours] are replaced with the line's name, oil and longevity. The same tokens work in the product page texts (selling points, marquee, comparison, perks, FAQ).

settings.label: Show on product cards
settings.info: Collection grid, product carousels and search results.

settings.label: Product page badge text
settings.info: Replaces the scent match badge on the product image. Products without a line keep the scent match badge.
